stories.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
stories.summary: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.

stories.title: Community safety report and new protections for teens
stories.summary: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT with expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new commitment to public safety reporting.

stories.title: Fair use benefits everyone
stories.summary: OpenAI shares excerpts from court briefs by creators, academics, accessibility advocates, and legal experts, among others, on how fair use supports AI training and innovation.

stories.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
stories.summary: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

stories.title: How we detect frontier model misalignment
stories.summary: OpenAI uses layered monitoring to detect frontier model misalignment and unauthorized agent behavior so responders can intervene before incidents escalate.
